title: Kitten
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#F4A259"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="18" ry="12" fill="#FFD08A"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="22" fill="#F4A259"/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="15" fill="#FFD08A"/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <polygon points="32,30 28,12 44,24" fill="#F4A259"/>
  <polygon points="34,28 31,17 42,25" fill="#FFB3C1"/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <polygon points="68,30 72,12 56,24" fill="#F4A259"/>
  <polygon points="66,28 69,17 58,25" fill="#FFB3C1"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="43" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2E6B4F"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="43" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2E6B4F"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="41" r="2" fill="#D4FFE0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="41" r="2" fill="#D4FFE0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points="50,50 47,53 53,53" fill="#FF8FA8"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 53 Q47 57 44 55" stroke="#C96B2E" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 53 Q53 57 56 55" stroke="#C96B2E" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="30" y1="48" x2="44" y2="50" stroke="#FFE0B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="53" x2="44" y2="53" stroke="#FFE0B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="48" x2="56" y2="50" stroke="#FFE0B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="53" x2="56" y2="53" stroke="#FFE0B8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#FFF4E0"/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="86" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#FFD08A"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="86" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#FFD08A"/>
  <!-- paw toes -->
  <line x1="33" y1="88" x2="33" y2="84" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="89" x2="36" y2="84" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="88" x2="39" y2="84" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="61" y1="88" x2="61" y2="84" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="64" y1="89" x2="64" y2="84" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="67" y1="88" x2="67" y2="84" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M74 72 Q88 68 86 54 Q85 46 78 48" stroke="#F4A259" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M74 72 Q88 68 86 54 Q85 46 78 48" stroke="#FFD08A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
